content:
From Corporate Data to Interactive Content

Aidea, an AI startup that transforms organizations’ documents and information sources into interactive, animated content in a matter of minutes, has secured a pre-seed investment from ENA Venture Capital and RePie Portföy. While the financial details of the investment were not disclosed, it was stated that the startup will use these funds to develop its product and expand into the MENA and European markets.

By bringing together various AI tools and models under one roof, Aidea enables users to manage the entire content creation process from a central dashboard. Outputs generated through the platform can be transformed into micro-learning modules featuring voiceovers, avatars, animations, and Q&A flows.

Over 40 Customized AI Agents

The platform uses AI agents focused on specific tasks to increase the speed and quality of content production. It enables the automation of processes and ensures seamless integration with LMS (Learning Management Systems), intranets, or similar enterprise infrastructures.

Some of the standout features of the Aidea platform include:

  • A custom AI layer that integrates with corporate data.
  • Process automation with over 40 customized AI agents.
  • Instant publishing capability via a centralized, rich editing tool.
  • The ability to transform scattered corporate information into a scalable (Enterprise AI) structure.

The founding team, led by CEO Ali Kemal Karabulut—who has a background at Microsoft—includes Ebru Zeybek (CSO) and İlter Sağ (CTO), both experts in technology and business development. The startup aims to become a global player in the Enterprise AI sector, particularly in the knowledge automation vertical.
